ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.summary: A persistent caching solution for arbitrary Python functions
A persistent caching solution for arbitrary Python functions

name: fleche-base
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: fleche
  version: "0.24.0"
  python_min: "3.11"

recipe:
  name: ${{ name }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4131f3d070f2cdbd3cb75ee9d707dcfb5edaeeebdb5aefe4884ab88e6ff51fef

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  # Minimal install: the actual built package with core runtime deps only.
  - package:
      name: fleche-base
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - setuptools >=64.0
        - setuptools-scm >=9
        - pip
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
        - pyiron_snippets
        - filelock
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - fleche
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - '*'

  # Full install: metapackage pulling fleche-base plus all optional runtime deps
  # and the digest hooks for numpy and pandas.  fleche-numpy and fleche-pandas
  # are released independently from fleche's repository and have feedstocks of
  # their own; they depend on fleche-base, never on this metapackage.
  - package:
      name: fleche
    build:
      noarch: generic
      # Bootstrap for 0.24.0: fleche-numpy and fleche-pandas need
      # fleche-base >=0.24, so they can only reach conda-forge after this
      # build has published it.  Revert this commit (and bump the build
      # number) once they are available.
      skip: true
    requirements:
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("fleche-base", exact=True) }}
        - cloudpickle
        - dill
        - sqlalchemy
        - bagofholding >=0.1.12,<0.1.17
        - fleche-numpy
        - fleche-pandas
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - fleche
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - '*'
      - files:
          source:
            - tests/
        script:
          - pytest -m smoke
        requirements:
          run:
            - pytest
            - hypothesis
            - cloudpickle
            - dill
            - sqlalchemy
            - bagofholding >=0.1.12,<0.1.17
            - fleche-numpy
            - fleche-pandas

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/pmrv/fleche
  documentation: https://fleche.readthedocs.io/
  repository: https://github.com/pmrv/fleche
  summary: A persistent caching solution for arbitrary Python functions
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - pmrv
